description: This Java source file defines the 'Rom' class, which manages a collection of 'Table' objects within a ROM image, including methods for adding, removing, populating, and retrieving tables, as well as handling file-related operations and GUI interactions.

classes.name: Rom
classes.description: Represents a collection of tables within a ROM file, handling table management, file data, and GUI interactions.

methods.name: refreshDisplayedTables
methods.description: Updates the displayed table nodes based on current settings and table categories.

methods.name: addTable
methods.description: Adds a new Table to the collection, updating the internal table nodes list.

methods.name: removeTable
methods.description: Removes a specified Table from the collection.

methods.name: getTableByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Table object by its name, throwing exceptions if not found or invalid.

methods.name: findTables
methods.description: Finds and returns tables matching a regex pattern.

methods.name: populateTables
methods.description: Populates tables with binary data, updating each table and registering updates.

methods.name: setEditStamp
methods.description: Sets an edit stamp in the ROM binary data at a specific address.

methods.name: setRomID
methods.description: Sets the RomID identifier.

methods.name: getRomID
methods.description: Returns the current RomID.

methods.name: getRomIDString
methods.description: Returns the ROM ID as a string.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ROM, including ID and tables.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with this ROM.

methods.name: getTables
methods.description: Returns a vector of all tables in this ROM.

methods.name: getTableNodes
methods.description: Returns the vector of table nodes.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename associated with this ROM.

methods.name: saveFile
methods.description: Serializes the current ROM data and tables into byte array form.

methods.name: clearData
methods.description: Clears all table data and closes associated GUI frames.

methods.name: getRealFileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the binary ROM data.

methods.name: setFullFileName
methods.description: Sets the full filename and updates GUI frame titles accordingly.

methods.name: isAbstract
methods.description: Checks whether the ROM is marked as abstract.

methods.name: setAbstract
methods.description: Sets whether the ROM is abstract.

methods.name: refreshTableCompareMenus
methods.description: Refreshes comparison menus across all tables.
